import json
f = '/root/entrainment_gated_ft/lm_eval_clean/1.3B-100B-RetNet-pure.json'
with open(f) as fh: data = json.load(fh)
r = data.get('results', {})

        keys = [k for k in sorted(r[t]) if 'stderr' not in k and isinstance(r[t][k], (int,float))]

        print(f'  {t}: {vals}')
"
